verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents a first-party zero retention policy covering inputs, outputs and user data, backed by SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certification. That addresses the retention side of the story, but only as a fixed vendor policy. Nothing shows user-facing controls such as configurable retention windows or deletion. Missing for 10: user-configurable retention settings, a deletion API or workflow, detailed retention documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: With our zero retention policy your inputs, your outputs, and your user data stay private. DeepInfra is SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified.
